name: Spear Sphere
description: Multiplayer caveman spear-throwing on a tiny planet. Ooga booga.

MODE.description: Mode every new rock (lobby) starts in: dotime (stone age to the end of the world, with armor), classic (Forever Stone) or coop (Tribe vs Bots: all humans against waves of bots). Each rock's chief can change it.

ERA_SECONDS.description: Seconds in each Do Time age. After the last one, a random natural disaster ends the round.

BOT_LEVEL.description: Bot brains new rocks start with, 1-10: 1 wanders around and lags, 5 is a fair fight, 10 barely misses.

BOTS.description: Bots fill each new rock up to this many cavemen (0-10, 0 = humans only).

MAX_PLAYERS.description: Most human players allowed on each rock at once.

MAX_ROOMS.description: Most rocks (separate games, each with its own lobby code) running at once on the dyno.
